infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: AccessMap uses your location to show nearby accessibility flags and to attach your location when you report a new flag.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: AccessMap uses your location in the background to keep accessibility flags near you up to date.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: AccessMap uses your location to show accessibility flags near you.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: AccessMap uses the camera to capture photos of accessibility barriers.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: AccessMap needs photo access to attach images to accessibility reports.
